essence: The practitioner performs deva-nyasa then matrka-nyasa in this manner.
The verse assigns the seed syllables aam and kshaam to that power.
After ambadevi, one speaks the infinite kula.
The verse assigns am and ksham to asitanga bhairava.
The verse assigns syllables and treats the rest by the previous pattern.
